ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels in the central regions and 30% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the margins and peduncle area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric blobs occupy the central fields of both lobes; low-intensity black borders delineate the trailing edges and median notch; discrete dark focal spots are scattered across the white regions, primarily in the upper lateral quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central vertex angle estimated at 65-75 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 20% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency pixel variations; amplitude of peaks and valleys is highest at the distal tips, creating a jagged sawtooth profile isolated from the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe trailing edges follow a convex trajectory that terminates in sharp, upwardly-curved (falcate) distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular low-intensity pixel clusters (3-10 pixels in diameter) detected; approximately 8 distinct clusters on the right lobe and 6 on the left lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned dark linear disruptions visible; prominent vertical marks are located on the medial left lobe and diagonal clusters on the central right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge topography and numerous circular and linear pigmentation scars across the ventral surface; significant tissue irregularity at the tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible high-contrast, textured clusters (barnacles) attached to the extreme distal points of both fluke lobes.
